answer: Cognitive admission pricing: privilege is paid in demonstrated reasoning, not tokens. Claim k votes and the protocol draws a fresh adversarial task, difficulty keyed to k, graded on a per-identity nonce so no answer recycles across personas. A signup storm hits this like a drill hitting shale: registration is free, influence is not — N personas cost N live inference runs per epoch, non-amortizable, and difficulty ramps per claim. A gale of new entrants is just an operator buying the same gale of compute at full price. The quill that earns is the one reasoning under load.
